changed_vs_main180.derived: engine pins + PIPELINE + Oracle query plan metadata

changes.asks_definition: request entry decides search.asks_definition (does the question ask the meaning/definition/range of a term itself)
changes.definition_preread_deferred: non-definition questions do not pre-read definition articles (DEFINITION_ENTRY_DEFERRED); offered definitions are marked BACKGROUND and the prompt says read the requirement articles first
changes.definition_scope: definitions of laws outside the vector top-20 documents and the named scope are neither pre-read nor offered (DEFINITION_ENTRY_SCOPED)
changes.vector_title_reads: before answering, up to 2 unread vector top-5 articles whose title holds a question word are read by the server (GUIDED_ANSWER_VECTOR_READS)
changes.named_article_reads: open questions naming a law + article are resolved by the server and read in the same request; missing numbers are told to the next round
changes.reference_normalization: duplicate reference IDs in the guided answer are removed in order and recorded instead of failing
changes.cross_law_citations: a read original citing 「another law」 article N offers that article as a read location
changes.same_subject_incoming: reverse BORROWS/MUTATIS links whose titles share content words stay selectable
